QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Heliseum Reclamation HQ
QuestInfo.0: Visit Beldar in Pantheon to let him know you'd like to join Heliseum Reclamation HQ.
QuestInfo.1: Magnus' forces are stronger than you expected. You've got to get to Heliseum Reclamation HQ fast, so you can help Edea and Piston, the commanders there.
QuestInfo.2: You found Tiron in Heliseum to see what you could do to help.

default.0: Take the stairs to the right and use the portal to #bHeliseum#k. #bTiron#k will be waiting for you with instructions.
